structured.answer: I'd open an account at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) and buy the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", which the page marks "הזול". With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years the page says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ in today's money. It assumes 2% inflation a year and a 7% yearly return.

stuck.why: I typed 750 but the slider showed 800, so for a moment I wasn't sure which one it was using

stuck.where: Tax tooltip above the cost bars
stuck.why: '(84% מהפסד)' reads like 'of a loss'. I didn't understand what loss it meant

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד'
Fields סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית / שנים
Result card 'הבחירה שלכם · הזול' 179,889 ₪ 'בכסף של היום'
Account box פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ
Fund box ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)
skipped: Fund tag chips (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח...)
Small text in the 'כל החשבונות' box
Rest of the page below the first fund cards
not_found: Any explanation of where the 7% return comes from

findings.what: The tax tooltip says '84% מהפסד', which reads like a loss and is scary and confusing
The slider shows 800 after typing 750 in the field
The inflation assumption is hidden behind a button and isn't shown next to the result
The cheapest fund company is a name I don't know (Yalin Lapidot), which made me hesitate
Lots of jargon tags under the funds
